{'text': '金伯利·格爾夫oyle在爭議聲中於週二辭去美國駐希臘大使職務後發了一則推文，但如果目的是想博取同情、改變敘事，她大概未能如願。', 'paragraph_context': 'Kimberly Guilfoyle fired off a tweet after she resigned as U.S. ambassador to Greece on Tuesday amid controversy, but if the purpose was to gain sympathy or reset the narrative, she probably was out of luck.'}

{'text': '《華爾街日報》近日一篇文章指稱，這位前霍士新聞評論員兼小唐納德·特朗普的前未婚妻，在2025年參議院確認其大使任命聽證會前，曾試圖要求一名特朗普捐贈者代其償還一筆十萬美元的美國運通卡債務。', 'paragraph_context': 'A recent Wall Street Journal article accused the former Fox News commentator and former fiancée of Donald Trump Jr. of attempting to get a Donald Trump donor to pay off a $100,000 debt to American Express ahead of her 2025 Senate confirmation hearing for the ambassadorship.'}

{'text': '格爾夫oyle在X平台發布了一則冗長的訊息，宣布自己即將離任，並表示「擔任駐希臘美國大使是畢生的榮幸」。', 'paragraph_context': 'Guilfoyle posted a lengthy message on X announcing that she was leaving the post, saying that “serving as the United States Ambassador to Greece has been the honor of a lifetime.”'}

{'text': '她補充說：', 'paragraph_context': 'She added:'}

{'text': '「我將永遠感謝唐納德·J·特朗普總統和國務卿魯比奧，給予我代表這個世界歷史上最偉大國家的非凡榮幸。」', 'paragraph_context': '“I will forever be grateful to President Donald J. Trump and Secretary of State Marco Rubio for entrusting me with the extraordinary privilege of representing the greatest country in the history of the world.”'}

{'text': '在列舉了她如何推動「特朗普總統的『美國優先』議程」，以及「鞏固我們與希臘的戰略聯盟，並為美國人民爭取實質成果」的實例後，她回應了引發其辭職的指控。', 'paragraph_context': 'After offering examples of how she advanced “President Trump’s America First agenda,” as well as “[strengthened] our strategic alliance with Greece, and [delivered] meaningful victories for the American people,” she then addressed the accusations that led to her resignation.'}

{'text': '她說：「這些指控完全不實，我打算積極捍衛我的名字、名聲和誠信。我不會讓虛假的指控來定義我數十年的公職生涯。」', 'paragraph_context': '“These allegations are false, and I intend to vigorously defend my name, my reputation, and my integrity,” she said. “I will not allow false accusations to define my decades of public service.”'}

{'text': '鑑於上週消息曝光時引發的強烈反彈，格爾夫oyle的帖文遭到嘲笑和質疑毫不意外。', 'paragraph_context': 'Considering the outcry when the story broke last week, it’s no surprise that Guilfoyle’s post was greeted with ridicule and skepticism.'}

{'text': '有人猜測，那篇冗長的告別帖甚至可能不是她自己寫的。', 'paragraph_context': 'Some people suggested Guilfoyle may not have even written her long goodbye note.'}

{'text': '一些人也不忘提及格爾夫oyle在2020年共和黨全國代表大會上的爆紅時刻——她當時高喊「最美好的還在後頭！」，結果引來網上大量嘲弄。', 'paragraph_context': 'A couple of people felt obliged to reference Guilfoyle’s viral moment during the 2020 Republican National Convention, where she screamed “the best is yet to come!” to much online mockery.'}
